name: Sale To POI Administrative Request V 08
definition: The SaleToPOIAdministrativeRequest message is sent by a sale system to POI System to request for an Administrative service.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

AdministrativeRequest.name: Administrative Request
AdministrativeRequest.definition: Information related to the administrative request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
